en: Colorized historic postcard view of a large three‑story neoclassical school building with a central portico featuring arched windows and ornate decoration. In front is a circular garden bed with flowers and pathways in a landscaped square. Two women in long dresses walk on the foreground path. The sky is blue with a few clouds. Red printed text at the top reads the city name on the left and the type of school on the right.
